note: Plain explanations. verified:false means no official source was checked for this explanation.

terms.explain_en: The university's decision that you may study in a programme.
terms.explain_zh: 大学决定你可以就读某个专业。

terms.explain_en: The conditions you must meet to be admitted, such as a minimum grade, credits in certain subjects and a language certificate.
terms.explain_zh: 被录取必须满足的条件，例如最低成绩、特定科目的学分和语言证书。

terms.explain_en: The last day on which your application must reach the university or uni-assist.
terms.explain_zh: 申请材料必须送达大学或 uni-assist 的最后一天。

terms.explain_en: A document from uni-assist that records how your foreign qualification and grade were evaluated; some universities ask you to upload it with a direct application.
terms.explain_zh: uni-assist 出具的文件，记录你的外国学历和成绩的评估结果；有些大学要求直接申请时上传。

terms.explain_en: Office that checks degrees from China, India and Vietnam and issues the APS certificate needed before a master's application.
terms.explain_zh: 审核来自中国、印度和越南的学历并签发 APS 证书的机构，申请硕士前需要该证书。

terms.explain_en: A copy of a document that an authorised office has stamped and signed to confirm it matches the original.
terms.explain_zh: 由授权机构盖章签字、确认与原件一致的复印件。

terms.explain_en: A list of the courses in a degree with their content, workload and credits; universities use it to check subject-area credits.
terms.explain_zh: 列出学位所含课程及其内容、学习量和学分的文件；大学用它核查各学科领域的学分。

terms.explain_en: Credits that measure workload; 60 ECTS correspond to one year of full-time study.
terms.explain_zh: 衡量学习量的学分；60 个 ECTS 学分相当于一年全日制学习。

terms.explain_en: Converting a foreign grade to the German scale from 1.0 (best) to 4.0 (lowest pass), usually with the modified Bavarian formula.
terms.explain_zh: 把外国成绩换算成德国的 1.0（最好）到 4.0（最低及格）分制，通常使用修正巴伐利亚公式。

terms.explain_en: A condition attached to an admission, for example passing extra courses within a set time.
terms.explain_zh: 附加在录取上的条件，例如在规定时间内通过补修课程。

terms.explain_en: The official letter that tells you that you have been admitted.
terms.explain_zh: 正式通知你已被录取的信函。

terms.explain_en: Registering as a student after admission; only then are you officially a student.
terms.explain_zh: 录取后注册成为学生；完成后才正式成为学生。

terms.explain_en: A fee students pay every semester, for example for student services; it is not tuition.
terms.explain_zh: 学生每学期缴纳的费用，例如用于学生服务；它不是学费。

terms.explain_en: A programme without a limited number of places: applicants who meet the requirements are admitted.
terms.explain_zh: 没有名额限制的专业：满足要求的申请人都会被录取。

terms.explain_en: A programme with a limited number of places, so applicants are ranked and not everyone who qualifies is admitted.
terms.explain_zh: 名额有限的专业，申请人会被排名，并非所有合格者都能被录取。

terms.explain_en: A limit on places; informally also the grade of the last applicant admitted in an earlier round.
terms.explain_zh: 名额限制；口语中也指往年最后一名被录取者的成绩。

terms.explain_en: A certificate showing that your German or English is good enough for the programme.
terms.explain_zh: 证明你的德语或英语水平足以就读该专业的证书。

terms.en: German language exam for university admission
terms.zh: 德国高校入学德语考试（DSH）
terms.explain_en: A German exam taken at universities, with results DSH-1 to DSH-3; many programmes ask for DSH-2.
terms.explain_zh: 在大学举行的德语考试，成绩分为 DSH-1 至 DSH-3；很多专业要求 DSH-2。

terms.en: Test of German as a Foreign Language
terms.explain_en: A standardised German test with four parts (reading, listening, writing, speaking), each graded TDN 3 to TDN 5.
terms.explain_zh: 标准化德语考试，分阅读、听力、写作、口语四部分，每部分成绩为 TDN 3 至 TDN 5。

terms.explain_en: A letter explaining why you want to study the programme and why you are a good fit.
terms.explain_zh: 说明你为什么想读这个专业、为什么适合的信。

terms.explain_en: A short, usually tabular overview of your education and experience.
terms.explain_zh: 简短的、通常为表格形式的教育和经历概述。

terms.explain_en: The semester that starts in autumn, usually in October.
terms.explain_zh: 秋季开始的学期，通常从十月开始。

terms.explain_en: The semester that starts in spring, usually in April.
terms.explain_zh: 春季开始的学期，通常从四月开始。

terms.explain_en: Official acceptance of a foreign qualification or of credits earned elsewhere.
terms.explain_zh: 对外国学历或在其他地方取得的学分的正式认可。

terms.explain_en: The school-leaving qualification that allows you to study at a German university; relevant for bachelor's admission.
terms.explain_zh: 允许你在德国大学学习的中学毕业资格；与本科录取相关。

terms.explain_en: A service that checks international applications for many German universities and charges a handling fee.
terms.explain_zh: 为许多德国大学审核国际学生申请并收取处理费的服务机构。

terms.explain_en: The fee uni-assist charges for processing an application, whatever the result.
terms.explain_zh: uni-assist 处理申请所收的费用，与结果无关。
